checks: Removed export creation, status, download and JSON attachment endpoints return 404 for users and integrations; no export queue is created
One integration credential publishes metrics and documents, reads data and receipts; no separate producer secret
Document retries, optimistic revisions, restore, immediate text search and vector indexing with deterministic fixture
Immutable metric contract and metadata edits retain measurements
Dimension-scoped reader cannot write, escape scope, inspect another receipt, manage integrations or create human users
Collection search and document ownership enforced; write grant cannot impersonate another metric publisher
Corrections and retractions authorize both old and new dimension scopes atomically
Saved snapshots revalidate current scopes after permission narrowing
Default-deny catalog/query/document access and application request quota
Event fanout checks every derived metric before accepting a batch and uses the same application credential
Unknown bearer credentials, cross-origin administration and disabled integrations are rejected
Document history retains current plus 20 revisions; archived content is removed from discovery
Stable collection/key reads preserve exact identifiers, UUID compatibility, title edits, history and archived access; collection/history permissions remain enforced
